'''The Red [[Quarren/Legends|Quarren]]''' was the only known name of a sea [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] that attacked sailors on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Lamaredd/Legends|Lamaredd]] c. [[29 BBY/Legends|29 BBY]]. A [[Bounty/Legends|bounty]] was offered for the pirate's capture.
